profile.summary: A family-owned fencing contractor in Livermore, California, operating since 1996. It installs and repairs chain link and ornamental fences and gates for commercial, industrial and public works projects, and supplies fencing materials, across the Bay Area.

sources.title: Chain Link Fence & Supply, Inc. Livermore, CA - filing information
